calls.statement:
SELECT 
    EXTRACT(MONTH FROM f.sale_date) as month,
    s.region,
    SUM(f.gross_amount) as total_gross,
    COUNT(*) as line_count
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_store s ON f.store_key = s.store_key
WHERE f.sale_date >= '2024-08-01' AND f.sale_date <= '2024-09-30'
GROUP BY EXTRACT(MONTH FROM f.sale_date), s.region
ORDER BY month, s.region

SELECT 
    s.region,
    SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(MONTH FROM f.sale_date) = 8 THEN f.gross_amount ELSE 0 END) as august_2024_gross,
    SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(MONTH FROM f.sale_date) = 9 THEN f.gross_amount ELSE 0 END) as september_2024_gross
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_store s ON f.store_key = s.store_key
WHERE f.sale_date >= '2024-08-01' AND f.sale_date <= '2024-09-30'
  AND s.valid_from <= f.sale_date AND s.valid_to >= f.sale_date
GROUP BY s.region
ORDER BY s.region

SELECT 
    staff_purchase_flag,
    COUNT(*) as line_count,
    SUM(gross_amount) as total_gross
FROM fact_sales_line
WHERE sale_date >= '2024-08-01' AND sale_date <= '2024-09-30'
GROUP BY staff_purchase_flag

SELECT 
    COUNT(*) as total_lines,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN gross_amount IS NULL THEN 1 END) as null_gross,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN store_key IS NULL THEN 1 END) as null_store,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN sale_date IS NULL THEN 1 END) as null_date,
    SUM(CASE WHEN gross_amount < 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as negative_gross_count
FROM fact_sales_line
WHERE sale_date >= '2024-08-01' AND sale_date <= '2024-09-30'

calls.statement:
SELECT 
    region,
    COUNT(DISTINCT store_id) as store_count,
    MIN(valid_from) as first_version,
    MAX(valid_to) as last_version
FROM dim_store
GROUP BY region
ORDER BY region

SELECT 
    s.region,
    SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(MONTH FROM f.sale_date) = 8 THEN f.gross_amount ELSE 0 END) as august_2024,
    SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(MONTH FROM f.sale_date) = 9 THEN f.gross_amount ELSE 0 END) as september_2024
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_store s ON f.store_key = s.store_key
WHERE f.sale_date >= '2024-08-01' AND f.sale_date <= '2024-09-30'
  AND s.valid_from <= f.sale_date AND s.valid_to >= f.sale_date
GROUP BY s.region
ORDER BY s.region
